---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new language feature, stdlib function, playground view, or toolchain component
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who hits it? Include a concrete example
(an Aether program that doesn't work today but would with the feature).

## Proposed design

Sketch the design — syntax, types, semantics. If it's a language feature,
say which stage(s) it touches (lexer, parser, sema, eval). If it's a
stdlib function, name the module. If it's a toolchain component, name the
RFC it relates to (see `docs/rfcs/`).

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider, and why is this better?

## Out of scope

What does this feature explicitly *not* try to do?

## Notes

Anything else useful — links to prior art, related issues, etc.
